headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty closed significantly lower as IT stocks faced heavy selling pressure.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Profit booking across sectors following recent market rallies
Heavy selling pressure in IT sector stocks dragging benchmark indices down
Surge in crude oil prices and weakening of the Indian rupee
Global market headwinds and cautious sentiment during Black Friday trading
whatHappening: Sensex crashed up to 1,000 points in the last trading session amid widespread selling
Nifty 50 fell below key levels of 25,900 and 25,700 during trading
Metal stocks showed relative strength and outperformed the broader market weakness
Bombay High Court cleared the path for the Tata Sons board meeting scheduled for November 30
summary:
In the last trading session, Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty suffered sharp losses driven by a sell-off in IT stocks.
Surging crude oil prices, rupee weakness, and profit booking contributed to Sensex dropping nearly 1,000 points.
The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 30 November.
